name: run_gsea
description: Gene Set Enrichment Analysis using gseapy Enrichr against MSigDB/KEGG/Hallmark gene sets
usage: from app.tools.biomni.genomics import run_gsea; result = run_gsea(['TP53', 'MYC', 'KRAS', 'EGFR'], gene_sets='KEGG_2021_Human', output_dir='output/')
returns: dict with keys: enriched_terms (list of {term, p_value, adjusted_p, overlap, genes}), n_significant, output_files
